points.point: Right way to handle a 503 on the status check (a read)
points.sentence: For a read, use a delayed, bounded retry.

points.point: Whether to send the post again
points.sentence: After a write, check for existing work first.

verdict.reason: The gateway-503 entry says to retry a read after a delay with a limit, and to check for existing work before repeating a write. That covers both the status-check 503 and the question of resending the post.
